one_line: An AI facial analysis breakdown demonstrating how lip volume visually alters facial proportions.

hook.what_happens: A photo of Sydney Sweeney toggles between original thin lips and augmented full lips.
hook.why_it_works: Challenges common assumptions about beauty and facial geometry immediately using a famous subject.

Interactive slider graphic animates lip volume from thin to full.
AI-generated side profile angle of the face.
Side-by-side comparison of two lip volumes on the same subject.

transcript.text: Think your lips are too thin?
This is the mouth you're picturing.
And it was never about size.
Lips are not a feature.
They are the line the lower face is measured from.
Your eye never measures a feature alone.
Move the lip line and every gap moves.
One. The gap between nose and lip.
Full lips make it short. Thin lips, long.
The nose isn't what changed.
Two. The chin.
The chin reads stronger.
The chin isn't what changed either.
Here is that range, on one face.
Watch the gap, not the lips.
Now turn it.
A front photograph hides it.
None of this means fuller is better.
It means lips are load-bearing.
On many faces, less is the change.
Do it now.
Roll your lips inward and hold it.
Watch your chin arrive.
See it on your own face.
A preview, not a promise.
Search Refina AI.

narrative_arc: Challenge popular aesthetic assumption regarding lip volume.
Introduce analytical concept of facial proportion and gaps.
Demonstrate proportional impact on philtrum and chin using visuals.
Engage viewer with an immediate physical action/test.
Direct viewer to search for the app solution.

cta.what: Search Refina AI to preview facial proportions.

subjects: Sydney Sweeney (celebrity photo subject used for AI demonstration)
what_makes_it_work: Reframes cosmetic perception as objective geometry and proportional physics.
Uses a recognizable celebrity to build immediate visual trust.
Includes a simple physical exercise to let viewers test the visual concept in real life.
Clean, technical graphic overlays give the analysis a scientific, authoritative feel.
